name: zentrola
description: Generate images and access Zentrola account information, including token usage and the current service provider.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and view Zentrola account information.
interface.longDescription: Reuse the Zentrola endpoint and Access Key already configured for Codex to generate PNG images, query token usage, and identify the current service provider.
defaultPrompt: Use $zentrola:imagegen to generate a PNG image from my description.
Use $zentrola:usage to query my current-month Zentrola token usage.
Use $zentrola:provider to show my current Zentrola service provider.
